# Go Green College Painters

## What We Are
Go Green College Painters is a student-owned, family-operated painting company based in Greater Grand Rapids, Michigan. Founded in 2024 by siblings Jackson and Evelyn Befus, the company has since expanded to include their younger siblings Henry (power washing) and Ella (vacation pet & plant care). All work is performed directly by the family — not subcontracted. Featured on Fox 17 Morning Mix in July 2026.

## Services
- **Exterior Painting**: Full exterior house and building painting, including prep and cleanup, built to withstand Michigan weather.
- **Interior Painting**: Interior room painting with floor and furniture protection, clean lines, and zero mess left behind.
- **Deck Staining**: Deck and fence cleaning, sanding, and staining using premium products to protect and renew weathered wood. Surface refinishing only — board replacement and structural carpentry are not offered (small imperfections are patched with wood filler).
- **Custom Mural & Design**: Custom painted murals, accent walls, and creative color designs for children's rooms, dining rooms, and commercial spaces. Designed and painted by Evelyn Befus.
- **Custom Painted Banners**: Hand-painted celebration banners for graduations, birthdays, sorority events, and special occasions. $150–$300. By Evelyn Befus.
- **Power Washing**: Decks, siding, driveways, patios, concrete, and fences. Run by 14-year-old Henry Befus under the Go Green Painters family brand.
- **Plants & Pets (Vacation Care)**: Vacation pet sitting (cats), plant watering, and home watch services for Grand Rapids homeowners while they travel. Run by Ella Befus under the "Go Green Plants & Pets" brand at https://gogreenpainters.com/plants-and-pets/. Cat visits $25, plant watering $20, home watch $15, full vacation package $35–40 per visit.

## Service Area
Greater Grand Rapids, Michigan and surrounding communities — with particular focus on Cascade, Forest Hills, Ada, and East Grand Rapids. Plants & Pets service is available within roughly 15 miles of downtown Grand Rapids.

## Contact
- Painting / power washing / murals: (616) 264-2119 or jack@gogreenpainters.com
- Vacation pet & plant care: (616) 500-4693 or ella@gogreenpainters.com
- Website: https://gogreenpainters.com
- Free estimates available — no obligation.

## Founders and Family
**Jackson Befus** — Co-Owner & Project Manager. Studying Communications and Entrepreneurship at Michigan State University. Discovered his love of painting restoring his father's vintage 36' sailboat. Manages project operations and client relations.

**Evelyn Befus** — Co-Owner & Creative Director. Studying Industrial Design at Wayne State University. Lifelong artist and illustrator specializing in custom murals and celebration banner work.

**Henry Befus** — Power Washing lead. Age 14. Runs the power washing service line under the Go Green Painters family brand.

**Ella Befus** — Plants & Pets founder. Age 17, headed to Michigan State University in fall 2027. Runs Go Green Plants & Pets vacation care service.

## Why Go Green
- Owner-operated: The Befus siblings do every job themselves, with no beginner crews or seasonal subcontractors.
- Fully insured on every job.
- Free, no-obligation estimates with transparent, honest pricing.
- Multi-generational: father paid his way through college painting in the 1980s.
- Featured on Fox 17 Morning Mix in July 2026.
- 11+ five-star Google reviews from homeowners across Cascade, Ada, East Grand Rapids, and Forest Hills.
- 100% satisfaction guarantee.
